feature_availability.seasonal_lift: calculated where historical same-month observations exist
feature_availability.regional_concentration: only calculated when state/region column exists and comparable values exist
feature_availability.search_diversity: only calculated when query/category column exists
feature_availability.event_lift: requires optional events.csv with event_date and optionally title
feature_availability.cross_platform_confirmation: requires optional cross_platform.csv with title/date and engagement metric columns
feature_availability.absolute_search_volume: not available from normalized Google Trends index

cautions: Google Trends indices are normalized relative interest, not absolute search counts.
A one-off non-zero observation is not sufficient evidence of a breakout.
Opportunity screening score is a transparent heuristic, not a calibrated probability.
IMDb title ratings are not joined to anime records unless a matching IMDb tconst key exists.
Video game sales are kept as a separate dataset unless a defensible title mapping is provided.
